channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Thai Baht: BoT caution keeps policy on hold – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank notes that the Bank of Thailand (BoT) kept its policy rate at 1.0% and signalled a cautious stance, prioritizing growth risks over inflation. USD/THB has risen for five consecutive sessions, up 0.9% to 33.43.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Gains constrained against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale notes that Indian money markets have continued to unwind tightening expectations, with the 1-year swap rate dropping to 5.75% and the 10-year IGB yield easing to 6.80%.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds above 101.50 ahead of US PCE inflation
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, continues its winning streak for the fourth successive day and is trading around 101.60 during the European hours on Thursday.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar rally pauses ahead of critical inflation data
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Thursday, June 25:

item.title: US Dollar: Cooler core PCE risks and peak rally view – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole argues the Dollar rally may be nearing its peak as calmer risk sentiment and softer Federal Reserve (Fed) pricing take hold.

item.title: ECB’s Schnabel: Interest rates need to raise further to bring inflation down to 2% target
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker Isabel Schnabel reiterates that the central bank is not done with monetary tightening yet, according to her remarks released by Econostream released during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Euro remains pinned near 13-month lows following soft German consumer confidence
item.description: The Euro (EUR) edges lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, extending its decline for the fourth consecutive day.

item.title: Gold: Rates repricing weighs on haven appeal – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that Gold has broken below $4,000/ounce after a weak spell since mid-March, as rising global front-end yields and fading debasement fears pressure precious metals.

item.title: British Pound: Risk of slide toward 1.3110 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that GBP/USD briefly broke below 1.3160 to 1.3140 before recovering to 1.3170, with intraday price action expected to probe 1.3130 while keeping 1.3110 out of reach.

item.title: Indian Rupee trades higher as oil prices return to pre-war levels
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades firmly against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday. The USD/INR pair declines to near 94.30 as the Indian currency strengthens due to a further decline in oil prices.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Softens to near 111.50 on intervention fears and bearish technical bias
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 111.50 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) amid fears of currency intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Holds near 2024 low against US Dollar – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes USD/JPY is trading close to its 2024 highs as resilient US data and elevated US yields underpin Dollar carry appeal.

item.title: Gold remains vulnerable below $4,000, November 2025 low as traders await US PCE data
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its bearish bias for the third straight day – also the sixth day in the previous seven – and trades below the $4,000 psychological mark heading into the European session on Thursday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Likely to find support near 0.6830 amid hawkish Fed bets
item.description: The AUD/USD pair trades marginally lower to near 0.6890 during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Soft data reinforce no-hike RBA view – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur says recent Australian labor market and inflation data provided little new momentum for the Australian Dollar (AUD) and support the view that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) is unlikely to hike again this year.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD hovers at seven-month lows around $57 with US inflation on tap
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) posts moderate losses on Thursday, trading at seven-month lows around $57.00 at the time of writing, after a nearly 12% sell-off in the previous two days.

item.title: Equities: Tech earnings offset Oil volatility – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team notes global equities ended slightly lower, with energy and materials dragging, but sector dispersion remained wide. Lower Oil prices are seen as a relief for consumers, while strong Micron results reinforced confidence in technology earnings.

item.title: Euro: Downtrend stretched near 1.1325 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note EUR/USD’s slide extended to 1.1324 before a rebound, with the pair now seen consolidating between 1.1330 and 1.1385 in the very near term.

item.title: Euro weakens against British Pound as markets pare back ECB hike bets
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross declines to around 0.8620 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Dovish remarks from the European Central Bank (ECB) policymakers weigh on the Euro (EUR) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: US core PCE inflation expected to rise in May as Fed rate hike bets increase
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) will publish the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index data for May on Thursday at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: WTI extends decline to pre-Middle East war levels around $69 as oil flows accelerate
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, is down 0.7% to near $69.00 during the late Asian trading session on Thursday.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: New Zealand Dollar falls to near 0.5650 as bearish bias prevails
item.description: NZD/USD remains weaker for the seventh successive day, trading around 0.5650 during the Asian hours on Thursday. Technical analysis of the daily chart suggests the spot price is moving downwards within the descending channel, reflecting a persistent bearish bias.

item.title: BoJ's Tamura says central bank should raise rates near neutral as inflation risks overshooting
item.description: Bank of Japan (BoJ) board member Naoki Tamura said on Thursday that Japan has already achieved the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) 2% inflation target and the central bank must raise rates near neutral to avoid underlying inflation from overshooting above target.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Consolidates below 1.4250/April 2025 highs as traders await US PCE
item.description: The USD/CAD pair enters a bullish consolidation phase during the Asian session on Thursday and currently trades around the 1.4230-1.4225 region, just below its highest level since April 2025 touched the previous day.

item.title: Swiss Franc rebounds as markets await US PCE data and monitor Lebanon-Israel tensions
item.description: The USD/CHF pair edges lower to around 0.8110, retreating from an 11-month high during the early European trading hours on Thursday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah receives support from foreign capital inflows
item.description: USD/IDR loses ground after three days of gains, trading around 17,970 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair depreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) gains ground on improved domestic market sentiment.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Japanese Yen bears turn cautious amid intervention fears, modest USD pullback
item.description: The USD/JPY pair edges lower during the Asian session on Thursday, albeit it lacks follow-through and finds support ahead of the 161.50 level.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Rebounds above 1.1350, but outlook stays bearish below key resistance
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1370 during the early European session on Thursday. A surprisingly hawkish message from Kevin Warsh as the new Federal Reserve (Fed) chair last week has traders pricing a US hike as soon as September.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Trades near 184.00 after rebounding from symmetrical triangle
item.description: EUR/JPY pares its daily losses, remaining in the negative territory and trading around 183.80 during the Asian hours on Thursday.
